ABOUT JUNE SHOP

What products does June Shop sell?
We specialize in all day-to-day needs like coin purses, water bottles, character pens, neck pillows, coffee mugs, pencil pouches, notebooks, pencils, colour pencils, soap dispensers, flasks, scented candles, optical cases, shopper bags, eye masks, soft towels, humidifiers that have knowingly or unknowingly become a part of our daily lives at home, office, school or college. We make sure that you have plenty of variations to choose from. We constantly keep adding to this list of products to make your shopping experience a joyous one. 

Why should I shop from June Shop?
With affordable pricing, attractive offers, and 100% genuine products, we will leave you pleasantly surprised. Each June Shop product is unique and will make you go 'wow'!

ORDERS & DELIVERY

How will I know that my order is confirmed?
You will receive an email and SMS on order confirmation. Please contact us if you don't - sales@thejuneshop.com / +91 8697111998. 

When will you ship my order?
We normally ship all orders within 4 - 7 business days. Final delivery time will vary based on delivery location. For further details, please check Shipping & Delivery

When will my order get delivered?
Transit and delivery time may vary depending on your location and the items ordered. We'll send you a link to track the status of your order. 

How much do you charge for delivery?
We offer free shipping on all orders.

How can I track my order?
An email is sent to you after the order is shipped. It contains the tracking number and details of the service provider.

If you are having trouble reading the emails or if you haven't received any updates, please get in touch with us immediately. 

What happens if there has been a delivery mishap with my order?
Send us an email to sales@thejuneshop.com and we will look into it right away! 

1. In the event of damaged products received, we'll require photo proof of the affected products and order details. We'll review your case and if fair, we will re-send the products to you at no cost, subject to availability. 

2. In the event of lost package, we will contact our delivery partner and if it's clear that your order is indeed lost, we'll re-send the order to you at no cost, subject to availability.

How do I place bulk orders?
Our products are simply awesome and buying one is just not enough! You can place bulk orders by contacting us at sales@thejuneshop.com or +91 8697111998. We offer customization as well. 

I don’t want the package to carry an invoice / amount as it is a gift. Can this be done?

Unfortunately, invoices are mandatory due to government regulations.

RETURNS & REFUND

Please read our Returns & Refund Policy here.

I have received a damaged product, what should I do?
In the event that you receive a damaged product, please initiate a return or reach out to us on sales@thejuneshop.com and we will resolve the issue to your satisfaction.

How do I cancel an order?
Before your order if shipped, you can send a request to sales@thejuneshop.com or call us +91 7003079822. After the order has been shipped, it cannot be cancelled. 

What is your return policy?
You can return certain products, up to 2 days from the date of delivery, you can send a request to sales@thejuneshop.com or +91 7003079822. The returned product should be in its original packaging and in the same unused condition as received.

What items can I replace?
You can replace all items that will be accepted only for damaged / defective issues. You need to inform us of any damages / defects within 48 hours of delivery of the product, in order to receive the replacement.

Do you arrange for reverse pick-ups?
 The June Shop has self ship policy for returning and exchange of a product. Since we do not have a reverse pick up facility, we would request the customer to self-ship the product to us. When we would receive the product then only we can initiate the process of return or exchange. The expense of the self-shipping would entirely be borne by the customer.

 Where do I mail the returns?

Please mail the item(s) to the address below:

The June Shop, EN-22, EN Block, 1st Floor, Salt Lake City, Sector V, Kolkata-700091, West Bengal.

When will I receive a replacement?
Replacement will be shipped after the original item has been received in the warehouse, subject to the following conditions:

  • The item(s) are unused, unsoiled and unwashed.
  • The packaging is intact. 
  • They are returned within 2 days from the delivery date.

Any returned item received by us that does not meet the above mentioned conditions will not be accepted. No amount will be reimbursed in this case.

Can I choose a different item in exchange?
You can only exchange your item within 7 days and receive a replacement of that exact product or another product of the same value. If the value of the replacement product exceeds that of the previously purchased product, the difference will have to be paid in advance.

What is your refund policy?
Refunds will only be processed for damaged or defective products either for paid or COD orders. Please note the shipping charge of Rs. 100 where applicable will not be refunded.

The June Shop is currently shipping all over India. At TJS we understand how important it is to receive your purchased products in the finest condition, and on time. Know this - we work around the clock to try and get you your products as soon as possible.

 ** The customer should reach out within 48hrs of delivery along with the image (Post 48 hours we will not be able to entertain any complaints). If the damage is reported within 48 hours; TJS will take action accordingly.

 Thank you for visiting and shopping at The June Shop. Following are the terms and conditions that constitute our Shipping Policy.

Domestic Shipping Policy Shipment: All orders are processed within 3-14 business days. If we are experiencing a high volume of orders, shipments may be delayed by a few days. Please allow additional days in transit for delivery. If there will be a significant delay in shipment of your order, we will contact you via email, Whatsapp or telephone. 

 

 GENERAL INFORMATION

  • All orders are subject to product availability. If an item is not in stock at the time you place your order, we will notify you through call and/or email.
  • Unless there are exceptional circumstances, we make every effort to fulfill your order within 14 working days of the date of your order. Business days mean Monday to Saturday, except holidays.
  • Please note we do not ship on Sundays or holidays
  • Date of delivery may vary due to carrier shipping practices, delivery location, method of delivery, and the items ordered. Products may also be delivered in separate shipments.
  • The customer can provide special delivery instructions on the check-out page of our website
  • Please note that online payments don’t require any additional delivery charges. However, COD orders are charged extra.
